payload.title: Reuse shared effects from Babulus without forks
payload.description:
## Behavior
As a Babulus author, I can use the shared VideoML effects after demos move.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given the actual published package dependencies and any development aliases, when Babulus consumes the new components, then existing demo names remain compatible or have a documented migration. Preview and export smoke tests use the same shared implementation; do not maintain duplicate effect code.

## Ownership
stdlib, player, toolchain, videoml-org; Babulus as consumer

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
